items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mike Wofford. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Mike Wofford. There’s a lot of good musicians here.

ctx.x: Mike Wofford. There’s a lot of good musicians here. But the people don’t, they don’t seem to support it. But you put that rock crap in there, and then man — and it’s funny, because people look at other people and call them savages, and then have they ever seen themselves when you put that [scats] oh my goodness. Ridiculous. But what did Buddy Rich say? Rock music is played by morons for imbeciles or something like that.
